title: Who&When Pro: Can LLMs Really Attribute Failures in AI Agents?
abstract: arXiv:2607.09996v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Automated failure attribution uses LLMs to identify where and why agentic systems fail. As agents become more capable, their failures become subtler, making automated attribution increasingly important. We introduce Who&When Pro, a large-scale benchmark for automated failure attribution in agentic systems. Using a strictly controlled pipeline that injects a failure only after exactly replaying a successful prefix, we construct 12,326 failed trajectories with golden labels across 3 modalities and 26 benchmarks covering various scenarios. Beyond benchmarking, we conduct extensive experiments and analyses, revealing systematic patterns in how models attribute failures across modalities, protocols, and model families, and providing empirical guidance for future automated failure attribution systems.

translated_title: Who&When Pro：大语言模型真的能为AI智能体进行失败归因吗？
translated_abstract: 自动失败归因利用大语言模型来识别智能体系统在哪里失败以及为什么失败。随着智能体能力不断提升，其失败变得更加隐蔽，这使得自动归因变得越来越重要。我们提出了Who&When Pro，一个面向智能体系统自动失败归因的大规模基准。通过一个严格控制的流水线——仅在精确重放成功前缀之后注入失败——我们构建了12,326条带有黄金标签的失败轨迹，涵盖3种模态和26个基准，覆盖多种场景。除了基准测试之外，我们还进行了广泛的实验与分析，揭示了模型在跨模态、协议和模型家族进行失败归因时的系统性模式，并为未来的自动失败归因系统提供了实证指导。
tldr: 提出大规模基准Who&When Pro，通过严格控制的失败注入流水线构建了12,326条带黄金标签的失败轨迹，系统评估并揭示了大语言模型在AI智能体失败归因任务中的表现规律与模式。
en_tdlr: Introduces Who&When Pro, a large-scale benchmark with 12,326 golden-labeled failed trajectories built via a strictly controlled failure-injection pipeline, systematically evaluating and revealing patterns in how LLMs attribute failures in agentic systems.
